name: Prospect list by role and firm type
summary: Before anyone writes a first note, you know which kinds of firm and which roles in them deserve your next conversations. Every firm is tested against your own criteria first and carries a sourced reason, a grade and the questions only a conversation can answer. Nobody is contacted.

sources.title: The working guide Fully Powered AI uses to build its own prospect lists: names only from a supplied source with roles recorded instead, size counted at the firm that receives the work, headquarters kept apart from offices, the door as a way in that is not a cold approach, the early-adopter sign, a next step kept separate from the grade, and do-not-contact marks that are never removed.

sources.contribution: The method our own guide adapted: a target profile written as a short statement with pass-or-fail criteria before any search, a source and date on every row, confidence that is high only when two independent sources agree, a note of what to leave out when writing to a firm, duplicates removed by domain, a suppression list carried forward, published general contact routes only, and no bulk extraction, no bypassed sign-ins and no sensitive traits. From the same repository's skills/competitor-profiling: a fact the pages do not show is not observed, which is not the same as absent, the basis, with swan-gtm's rule below, for recording a criterion as not observed, with the pages checked and when.

Keeping company fit apart from signs that the status quo is changing; each criterion as confirmed, disconfirmed or unknown, with an unknown turned into a question rather than a pass; each signal read as the observed fact, what it may mean, what supports or weakens it and what is still unknown; a strong signal never overriding a failed fit and fit without a signal held on watch; a condition that would change every watch or pass; the single next action for each firm; and the one-sentence test of a finished verdict.

Testing firms against the firm-level criteria before looking at anyone who works there, keeping the firm records apart from the people records, and a quality check on the finished list before it is used.
